name: Two-Control Oriented Bipartite-Graph Construction
definition: For a finite simple bipartite graph $G$ with one orientation per edge, use one private coordinate per vertex and controls $0,1$. The fiber at empty private support is $\{0,1\}^2$; the singleton fiber at $v$ is the control square with $00$ deleted on the left side and $11$ deleted on the right side; an edge fiber is the singleton $01$ when directed left-to-right and $10$ when directed right-to-left; all other fibers are empty.
parameters: Finite oriented simple bipartite graph $G$ with $m$ vertices and $e$ edges; the vertex-free graph gives the control square.
properties: The class has $m+2$ coordinates and $4+3m+e$ concepts. It is dismantlable ample and finite convex-treelike, has VC dimension two, and is convex-realizable exactly when the orientation is acyclic. Reflecting control $0$ makes it intersection closed; subsequently reflecting every coordinate gives a union-closed well-graded orientation.
